question: Who among the following is the author of the book 'Amnesty'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aravind Adiga**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Amnesty** is a **novel **written by **Aravind Adiga**.

 
 
• It tells the **story **of a **Sri Lankan migrant** in **Sydney who agonises over whether **to **tell **the **police **about a **murder **and **risk deportation**.
 
• **Amnesty **tells the story of **Danny**, a **Sri Lankan **who has become an “**illegal alien**” after **dropping **out of his “**ripof**f” **college**. 
 
• He is **surprisingly **content cleaning **apartments **in **suburban Sydney **when one of **his clients **is **murdered **by **another**.
 
• Over the **next 24 hour**s, **Danny **contends with the **dilemma **of **whether **to risk **deportation **by informing the police.
 
• **Amnesty **lays **bare Australia’s hypocrisies **and **contradictions**.
 
• **Immigration **props up the **economy and **yet is subject to the **most draconian restrictions** in the west – a region the country claims a membership of against all geographic evidence.
 
• **Adiga's debut novel**, **The White Tiger**, won the **2008 Booker Prize** and has been adapted into a Netflix original movie The White Tiger.
 
• **Other books** written by him are: **Between the Assassinations**,** Last Man in Tower**, **Selection Day**.
